// A pie slice: the region swept from the circle's center over the angular
// interval Sweep, bounded by two radii and the arc between them. Angles are
// measured from +X, counter-clockwise.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Circular_sector)
type CircularSector
    implements IGeometry2D, IClosedShape, IConnected, IArea, IBounded2D, ICentroid2D, IContainsPoint2D
{
    Circle: Circle;
    Sweep: AngleInterval;
}
